scientific_integrity: The exact Markov recursion, log-time coupling, and Harris drift/minorization are proved. The published moment asymptotics are appropriately credited. Finite checks are diagnostic only.
scientific_limitations: Distributional convergence only for the root-only doubling model; no almost-sure limit, closed-form invariant density or height asymptotics. Moment determinacy is not asserted. Harris ergodicity uses the explicitly verified small-set and drift conditions; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Weak convergence of root-doubling tree size through a logarithmic-time jump process
